newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi to launch online business support service.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi to launch online business support service.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd said on Wednesday it would start an online business support service that will allow member firms to access information on other members and eventually conduct transactions electronically.
The service will start in September 1997 and be offered to 2,100 companies, 10 percent of which will be Hitachi units, Hitachi said in a statement.
Hitachi said it expects to boost membership to 4,000 firms in two years as part of a plan to establish the service as the global standard.
The service will help member firms cut costs for various business activities and expand their businesses, it said.
Through the service, member companies can obtain information on other companies' products, technologies, orders and business plans, Hitachi said.
The service will be expanded to include remittances, information on distribution and other business activities, Hitachi said.
